maeo_2024_hamstring_lset_vs_nht.joint_and_mechanism: Knee flexors / hamstrings (BFlh MRI aponeurosis) — lengthened-state eccentric (LSET) vs Nordic hamstring (NHT) vs CON (n=42, 12 wk)
maeo_2024_hamstring_lset_vs_nht.verdict: HOLD (confirmed MRI connective-tissue hypertrophy +7.55 pp vs CON, but all control-adjusted strength gains +9.07..+13.00 pp fail FORCE20 and all active LSET-1.25xNHT contrasts cross zero; no loaded tendon strain or individual data).

mersmann_2021_functional_high_load_patel.verdict: HOLD (clinically prevents patellar tendinopathy: 0/16 vs 5/15 worsening, p=0.016, but yields NO strength-rate superiority over active control: group p=0.50, interaction p=0.44).

werkhausen_2019_achilles_running_strain.joint_and_mechanism: Ankle plantarflexion isometric training (10 wk, n=11 TR vs n=10 CON) with same-pose AT stiffness and in vivo running AT lengthening
werkhausen_2019_achilles_running_strain.verdict: HOLD (control-adjusted torque +9.23 pp far below FORCE20 +20 pp; passive control fails ADAPT25).

martinez_2022_patellar_eccentric_executi.arms: EG6s (n=17) vs EG3s (n=18) vs CG (n=15), 6 wk single-leg decline squat + 6 wk detraining
martinez_2022_patellar_eccentric_executi.verdict: HOLD (proximal PT thickness time x group p=0.037, but no published maximal external strength/MVC contrast or loaded tendon capacity).

oberg_2025_multi_site_bfr_vs_hlrt.centner_2022_2023_bfr_vs_hlrt: BFR matches rather than exceeds HLRT by +25% (leg press 34% vs 37%; PF 44% vs 43%), lacks untreated control arm in 2022/2023, and individual tables are closed/paywalled.

individual_swv_validity_test.reused_source: SRC-0131 (Zenodo 14259356, Vesterhus et al. 2025) — strictly new non-destructive SWV validity test, no re-audit of EXP-0142 strength contrasts
individual_swv_validity_test.ruling: Resting patellar SWV change does NOT significantly track loaded tensile stiffness adaptation or CSA change at the individual human level (n=21, r=+0.216, p=0.3470, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.187; +0.587]), disqualifying resting SWV as a stand-alone safety proxy.

summary_ruling: Expanding Stage 1 across 4 anatomical sites (ankle, knee/patellar, hamstring/BFlh, shoulder/supraspinatus) and 5 internal training mechanisms (lengthened-state eccentric, Nordic eccentric, functional high-load patellar, eccentric execution time, low-load BFR) confirms Stage 1 DATA_BLOCKED is a general empirical limit of open human datasets, not specific to Kubo-Ishigaki or leg press.
